title: Eligibility standards.
bodyText: The eligibility of exceptional children for instruction, special facilities, and special services shall be determined in accordance with those standards established by the department.
bodyHtml: [§302A-439]  Eligibility standards.  The eligibility of exceptional children for instruction, special facilities, and special services shall be determined in accordance with those standards established by the department. [L 1996, c 89, pt of §2]
